title: Assault: Lost Time and Full Healing
kjv_text: And if men strive together, and one smite another with a stone, or with his fist, and he die not, but keepeth his bed: If he rise again, and walk abroad upon his staff, then shall he that smote him be quit: only he shall pay for the loss of his time, and shall cause him to be thoroughly healed.
summary: Non-fatal fight injuries are settled civilly: the striker pays for the victim's lost work time and full medical recovery, then is quit.
original_audience: Israelite men whose brawls were village facts of life.
immediate_context: Transition from capital law to the tort schedule: intent and outcome start producing money judgments instead of blood.
historical_context: Hammurabi 206 is nearly identical (oath of no intent + physician's fees). 'Loss of time' and 'thoroughly healed' are the two heads of damages every tort system since has reinvented: lost wages and medical costs. The victim surviving to walk 'upon his staff' functions as the causation cutoff.
penalty: Compensatory damages: lost time plus complete cure. No further liability.
exceptions: If the victim dies, homicide law (vv.12-14) resumes control.
nt_passages: Matthew 5:25-26 — 'agree with thine adversary quickly' endorses pre-trial settlement
Luke 10:34-35 — the Samaritan pays the full-healing measure voluntarily
usofc_implementation: Title IV's civil assault track, administered by the RA: statutory damages equal documented lost earnings plus 'thorough healing' — unlimited medical liability until certified recovery. Insurers invented Staff-Walk Certification (the moment the victim ambulates, liability caps) and now employ most of the country's physical therapists as adjusters.
constitutional_analogue: Ordinary tort law; 'cause him to be thoroughly healed' is more generous than most US workers' comp schedules — a fact plaintiff-side lawyers preach like scripture.
scene_ideas: A Staff-Walk Certification exam where the victim's limp is worth forty thousand shekels a month and everyone films everyone.
An insurance adjuster-physiotherapist torn between the oath she took and the cap she's paid to trigger.
satirical_uses: The one Covenant statute that produced a genuinely better outcome than the old regime is the one insurers spent a decade re-breaking.
